display.purpose: List and item titles (Space Grotesk 700, clamp 32 to 44 px).

heading.purpose: Page and dialog headings (Space Grotesk 700, 30 px).

label.purpose: Counts, years, pages, prices, key hints, uppercase group labels (Geist Mono, 12 px).

radius.name: sm
radius.purpose: Small tiles: row thumbnail, service tiles, checkboxes, skeleton rows.

radius.name: md
radius.purpose: Controls: buttons, inputs, selects, menu items, tree rows, tooltips.

radius.name: lg
radius.purpose: Containers: cards, covers, menus, popovers, toasts, toolbars.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Hover on floating controls (dark: black at 0.5).

shadows.name: accent
shadows.purpose: Removed: the primary button is flat.

surfaces.name: material-strong
surfaces.purpose: Raised layers (dialogs, drawer, detail panel), solid. No blur.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for all transitions, 150ms fast and 200ms base.

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Quick add, the one ink button. Text-colour fill; never used for other actions.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered on the ground, no shadow.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Hairline border, 8px radius, surface on focus.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Full pill for tags. The list type and count chip is a two-part exception with 8px outer corners.

components.name: List Row
components.description: Medium row, about 68px: 36x50 thumbnail, title with the first pinned field under it, the second pinned field on the right in mono.

components.name: Floating Menu
components.description: Solid raised surface, 12px radius, hairline ring and a soft shadow. No blur.

narrative.overview: A calm, personal collection browser for two people, set like a printed catalogue. A geometric display face carries the titles, a quiet UI face carries everything else, and near-white and near-black neutrals keep images in front. One electric blue marks what can be acted on. Hairlines separate; shadows only lift floating layers. Light and near-black dark share the same structure.
keyCharacteristics: Solid surfaces only: no blur, no backdrop-filter, no gradients, no glow.
Space Grotesk for titles, Geist for UI and body, Geist Mono for numbers and labels; all three self-hosted (Latin subset).
One blue accent. Quick add is the one ink button.
Radius 6, 8, 12, 16 px; full only for tags.
Medium list rows of about 68 px with the pinned fields in two slots.
150-200ms ease-out; springs only on button press.

rules.name: The Acting-Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue marks what can be acted on or focused. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Ink-Action Rule
rules.body: Quick add is the only ink button; every other primary action is blue.

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Rule
rules.body: Components use semantic tokens and the type, radius and shadow utilities; no raw hex or Tailwind palette in components.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Prices, counts, years and pages are set in Geist Mono (or tabular figures).

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: Nothing is frosted or translucent over content. Floating layers use the solid surface utilities.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from the 1px hairline first; a shadow only lifts a floating layer.

dos: Do take colour, type, radius, shadow and spacing from the tokens and utilities in src/styles.
Do use the solid surface utilities for floating chrome, with a shadow from the vocabulary.
Do pair every state colour with text or an icon.
Do keep motion at 150-200ms ease-out and honour reduced motion.
Do use a neutral fill tile when an image is missing.
donts: Don't blur, frost or gradient any surface.
Don't add a second accent, per-list colours or a second ink button.
Don't hard-code hex, Tailwind palette classes, radii or sizes in components.
Don't fetch fonts or icons at runtime, or add a web font outside src/styles/fonts.css.
